title: Choice independence of the normalized diagonal orientation
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, $q=p^a$ with $a\ge1$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\ge1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a smooth separated finite-type $k$-morphism of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small pro-etale sites, the derived pullback and tensor, and the constructible exceptional functor $Rf^!$ [def-pur-co-smoothness]. Put $\omega_f=Rf^!A_Y$.
Put $W=X\times_YX$, let $p_1:W\to X$ be the first projection and $\Delta:X\hookrightarrow W$ the diagonal. Set $C_\Delta=L\Delta^*Rp_1^!A_X$ and let $\alpha:C_\Delta\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_f$ be the specified diagonal base-change comparison [lem-pur-diagonal-base-change]. Let $\pi:N_\Delta\to X$ be the rank-$d$ normal bundle with zero section $z$ [def-pur-normal-bundle, lem-pur-diagonal-regular-immersion], and put $C_N=Lz^*R\pi^!A_X$ [def-pur-section-invariant].
For $i=1,2$, let $\delta_i:C_\Delta\xrightarrow{\sim}C_N$ be a DNC comparison normalized to the identity on standard zero-section pairs [thm-pur-dnc-invariance], realized using any etale coordinate cover near $\Delta$. Let $t_i:R\pi_!A_{N_\Delta}(d)[2d]\to A_X$ be a vector-bundle integration realized using any trivializing cover and frames, restricting on every trivializing open to the specified Kummer-normalized affine-space trace [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity]. Write $\beta_i:C_N\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X(d)[2d]$ for the zero-section restriction of the inverse adjoint vector-bundle purity map defined by $t_i$, with the canonical finite-coefficient site comparison and twists [cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity, def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Then the two derived morphisms
$$\Pi_i=\beta_i\circ\delta_i\circ\alpha^{-1}:\omega_f\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X(d)[2d]$$
are equal and are the specified canonical orientation of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object]. Thus the diagonal/DNC construction with this fixed normalization is independent of its etale coordinates, trivializing covers and bundle frames. This includes $d=0$. No assertion of uniqueness among arbitrary isomorphisms $\omega_f\cong A_X(d)[2d]$ is made.

proof.text: Apply uniqueness in existsUnique_dncInvariance to the two normalizations; their predicate is exactly DiagonalChoiceDncNormalized. This gives equality of the actual DNC isomorphisms.

Apply the existing unique normalized integration-gluing theorem. By fullness of the single-degree embedding, every normalized derived trace can be written using the same normalized source identification and a sheaf map. Both resulting pairs satisfy its uniqueness predicate, so their sheaf maps and hence their derived traces agree. This uses the definition-level gluing theorem directly rather than the larger ambient vector-purity theorem.

The adjunction hom equivalence is a function. Equal traces therefore have equal displayed transposes. The two gamma homs agree, so Iso.ext gives equality of gamma, and substitution gives the first asserted equality of three-factor composites.

The selected vectorBundleIntegration satisfies the same frame normalization. The uniqueness argument identifies the first trace with it. Apply the normal-model section orientation theorem to the canonical conormal vector bundle, the actual normal cone and the canonical projection- and zero-preserving model. Mapping the resulting equality by the finite site comparison and composing the fixed normal comparison identifies diagonalChoiceBeta with chartDiagonalBeta.

DNC uniqueness identifies the first delta with chartDiagonalDelta. Substitute this equality and the beta equality. The global canonical assembly theorem identifies the resulting fixed three-factor composite with diagonalDualizingObject, giving the second asserted equality.
